reference: Voqealar sodir bo'lgan vaqt umumiy holda Yuqori o'rta asrlar deb ataluvchi Yevropa tarixidagi 11, 12 va 13-asrlardir (m. 1000–1300 yillar).

source: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
reference: Romantizmda Gyote, Fixte hamda Shlegel singari yozuvchilardan qolgan madaniy determinizmning yirik elementi bor edi.

source: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
reference: Dastlab ko'ylakka sharqdagi Vizantiya madaniyati kuchli ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

source: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
reference: Submadaniyatlar a'zolarning yoshi, etnik kelib chiqishi, sinfi, joylashuvi va/yoki jinsiga qarab ajralib turishi mumkin.

source: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
reference: Boshqalarning hayvonlar tarafidan katta qilingani da'vo qilinadi; ba'zilarining yovvoyi tabiatda o'zlari yashaganligi aytiladi.

source: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
reference: Homiylik parvarishi ular chiqarib olingan uyda yetishmaydigan barcha zaruriy narsalar bilan ta'minlashi kerak.

source: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
reference: Internetning alohida xususiyatlari undan foydalanish hamda mamnun etuvchi yondashuv borasida qo'shimcha o'lchamlarga yetaklaydi.

source: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
reference: Misol uchun, "ta'lim" va "ijtimoiylashuv" internetdan foydalanish uchun muhim motivatsiyalar sifatida taklif qilinadi (Jeyms va boshqalar, 1995).

source: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
reference: Xususan, kichik ifodalarni to'g'ri talqin qilish orqali kishi yolg'on gapirayotgani yoki yolg'on gapirmayotganligini aniqlash mumkin, deya da'vo qilinmoqda.

source: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
reference: Savannadan tashqarida, inson kabi ovqat hazm qilish tizimiga ega bo'lgan primat uchun aminokislotaga bo'lgan ehtiyojni mavjud o'simlik manbalaridan qondirish mushkul.

source: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
reference: Bundan farqli o'laroq, mavjudot ozuqalar (chumolilar, termitlar, tuxumlar) nafaqat yengil hazm bo'ladi, balki ular muhim aminokislotalarning barchasini o'z ichiga olgan yuqori miqdordagi oqsillar bilan ham ta'minlaydi.

source: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
reference: Barcha narsalar hisobga olingan holda, agar ajdodlarimiz o'zlarining "oqsil muammolarini" bugungi kunda savanna shimpanzelariga o'xshash usulda hal qilgan bo'lsalar, ajablanmasligimiz kerak.

source: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
reference: Uyqu uzilishi — bu sizning odatdagi uyqu vaqtingizdan atay uyg'onish va qisqa vaqtdan keyin (10–60 daqiqa) uyquga ketish jarayonidir.

source: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
reference: Agar siz uyqudaligingizda soatni o'chirib qo'yayotgan bo'lsangiz, uni xonaning boshqa burchagiga qo'yishingiz mumkin, bu holda uni o'chirish uchun o'rningizdan turishingizga to'g'ri keladi.

source: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
reference: Germaniya Ikkinchi jahon urushida SSSR bilan AQSH o'rtasidagi hamkorlikka sababchi bo'lgan umumiy dushman edi. Urush tugashi bilan tizim, taraqqiyot jarayoni hamda madaniyat to'qnashuvlari davlatlarni o'zaro nizoga boshladi.

source: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
reference: Lekin Sovet Ittifoqi qizil armiyasining 800 000 dan ortiq askarlari Riga tinchlik shartnomasi, Tajovuz qilmaslik to'g'risidagi Sovet-Polsha pakti hamda boshqa ikki tomonlama va ko'p tomonlama shartnomalarni buzgan holda Polshaning sharqiy hududlarini bosib olgandan so'ng Belorussiya va Ukrainaga kirishi hamda frontlar yaratganida mazkur rejalar deyarli bir kechaga eskirgandi.

source: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
reference: Uning 78 tavsiyasidan birinchisi shuki, shu yil oxiriga qadar Iroq chegaralarini tajovuzlardan himoya qilish va qo'shnilar bilan diplomatik aloqalarni qayta tiklashga oid yangi diplomatik choralarni boshlash lozim.

source: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
reference: Mahsulotlarni tashish uchun kemalardan foydalanish yirik miqdordagi insonlar va mahsulotlarni okeanlar bo'ylab harakatlantirishning eng samarali usulidir.

source: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
reference: Shu bilan birga Nemis dengiz floti, asosan, dengizosti qayiqlaridan foydalanib, ushbu transport harakatini to'xtatishga urinayotgandi.

source: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
reference: Echkilar ilk bor 10 ming yilcha avval Eronning Zagros tog'larida qo'lga o'rgatilgan ko'rinadi.

source: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
reference: Kecha kechqurun Buenos-Ayresdan 50 km (31 mil) uzoqlikdagi La Platada amaldagi senator va Argentinaning birinchi xonimi Kristina Fernandes de Kirshner prezidentlikka o'z nomzodini qo'yishini ma'lum qildi.

source: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
reference: Ikkilik raqamlar faqatgina ikkita qiymatdan biriga ega bo'la oladi, misol uchun 0 yoki 1 hamda mazkur raqamlar kompyuter jargonida foydalanish uchun bitlar yoki ikkilik raqamlar deb yuritiladi.

source: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
reference: Butun Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlari bo'ylab taxminan 400 000 ta parishonxotirlik sklerozi (MS) holatlari ma'lum bo'lib, bu yoshroq va o'rta yoshdagi kattalar orasida yetakchi nevrologik kasallik bo'lib qolmoqda.

source: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
reference: Ilm-fanning asosiy maqsadi ilmiy usul orqali dunyoning qanday ishlashini aniqlashdir. Aslini olganda, bu usul boshqa ko'plab ilmiy izlanishlarga yo'lboshchilik qiladi.

source: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
reference: Tashqi davriy signallarga oddiygina javob bo'lmagan davriy ritmlar ko'plab tirik jonzotlar, jumladan, bakteriya, zamburug', o'simlik hamda hayvonlar uchun hujjatlashtirilgan.

source: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
reference: Biologik soatlar hattoki tashqi signallar bo'lmaganida ham avtonom harakatlanish davrini davom ettiruvchi avtogeneratordir.

source: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
reference: Dafn marosimida ishtirok etish uchun to'rt milliondan ko'proq kishi Rimga tashrif buyurdi.

source: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
reference: Faqatgina jinsiy hujayralardagi mutatsiyalar bolalarga o'tishi mumkin, boshqa har qanday yerdagi mutatsiyalar hujayraning nobud bo'lishi yoki saratonga sabab bo'lishi mumkin.

source: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
reference: Tabiatga asoslangan turizm tabiat, jumladan, o'simliklar hamda hayvonlarning yovvoyi hayotidan zavqlanish maqsadida tabiiy hududlarga tashrif buyurishga qiziquvchi kishilarni o'ziga jalb qiladi.

source: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
reference: Kelganlar soni shu qadar ko'p ediki, barchaning Avliyo Peter maydonidagi dafn marosimiga kirishi imkonsiz edi.

source: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
reference: Yaxshiki, haydovchilar o'zini oqilona izchil doirada tutishga moyil; shu sababli qatnov oqimlari bir oz oqilona izchillikka ega va matematik jihatdan taxminan ifodalanishi mumkin.

source: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
reference: Bir necha ming yil avval Aristarx ismli kishi Quyosh tizimi Quyosh atrofida aylanishini aytgan.

source: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
reference: Amazonka yer yuzidagi eng katta va ikkinchi eng uzun daryodir. U ikkinchi eng katta daryodan 8 karra ko'proq suv tashiydi.

source: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
reference: Toshdan piramida qurish Qadimgi qirollikning oxirigacha davom etganligiga qaramasdan, ular Giza piramidalaridan o'zlarining o'lchamlari va qurilishdagi texnik afzalliklari jihatidan hech qachon ustun bo'lmagan.

source: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
reference: Vatikan shahri aholisi 800 kishi atrofida. U dunyodagi eng kichik mustaqil davlat va eng kam aholiga ega mamlakatdir.

source: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
reference: Vatikan shahrining barcha aholisi katolikdir.

source: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
reference: Faylasuf Aristotel barcha narsa to'rt unsurning bir yoki bir nechtasi aralashmasidan tashkil topgan degan nazariyani ilgari surgan. Ularni tuproq, suv, havo va olov ekanligini aytib o'tgan.

source: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
reference: Tarixchilar agentlikning muvaffaqiyat darajasini kuchaytirish uchun osongina hal qilish mumkin bo'lgan, ayniqsa avtomobil o'g'rilanishi bo'yicha ishlarga resurslarning qaratilganligi uchun FQB agentligining o'tmishdagi siyosatlarini tanqid qildilar.

source: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
reference: Shu tarzda, qalam paydo bo'lganida ko'pchilik uchun yaxshi do'st edi.

source: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
reference: Afsuski, yozuvning yangi usullari vujudga kelganligi tufayli qalam quyi maqomga va kamroq foydalanish darajasiga tushib qoldi.

source: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
reference: Yaqin joyda mariya ko'proq bo'lishi mumkin, chunki qobiq yupqa. Lavaning yuzaga chiqishi osonroq bo'lgan.

source: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
reference: Spektrning boshqa uchida, bir inson jamoa shu paytgacha qilgan barcha narsalarni o'zgartirish va uni o'zlarinikini qilish kerak deb hisoblovchi tanib bo'lmaydigan shaxsga aylanadi.

source: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
reference: "Ko'rinmas jamoa" — bu a'zolarning har biri hisobot beruvchi boshqaruv jamoasidir. Ko'rinmas jamoa har bir a'zo uchun standartlarni belgilab beradi.

source: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
reference: Ta'lim tashkiloti nima sababdan tashkillashtirish uchun ko'p vaqt talab qiladigan jarayondan o'tishni xohlar ekan? Tashkiliy ta'lim konsepsiyalarini amaliyotga tatbiq etishning bitta maqsadi — innovatsiyadir.

source: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
reference: o'rta zveno betsmenlari Sachin Tendulkar va Rahul Dravid yaxshi o'yin ko'rsatdi va birgalikda yuz ran to'plagan sheriklarga aylandi.

source: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
reference: Biroq sardor viketini yo'qotganidan keyin, Hindiston uzatmalarni yakunlash uchun 7 ta viket yo'qotishlar bilan faqatgina 36 ta ranni amalga oshirdi.

source: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.
reference: AI bo'yicha tadqiqotlar aqlli xatti-harakatlar talab etiluvchi vazifalarni avtomatlashtirish uchun mashinalar yaratishdan iborat.

source: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
reference: Bloglar talabalarning yozish mahoratini yaxshilashga ham yordam beradi. Talabalar ko'pincha o'z blog tajribasini pala-partish grammatika va imlo bilan boshlasa-da, auditoriyaning borligini odatda buni o'zgartiradi.

source: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
reference: Talabalar ko'p hollarda eng tanqidiy tinglovchilar bo'lganligi tufayli, bloger tanqiddan qochish uchun yozayotganlarini yaxshilashga intiladi.

source: Large areas further north are quite sparsely populated and some is nearly uninhabited wilderness.
reference: Yanada shimolroqdagi katta hududlarning aholisi juda siyrak, ayrim yerlar esa qariyb kimsasiz sahrodir.

source: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa.
reference: Sharqiy Afrika orollari Afrika qit'asining sharqiy sohillari bo'yidagi Hind ummonida joylashgan.

source: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
reference: Ayollar: Oilaviy holatidan qat'i nazar, barcha ayol sayyohlarga o'zlarini turmush qurgan deb aytish tavsiya etiladi.

source: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
reference: Ayollar madaniy farqlarning ular ta'qib qilish deb hisoblovchi narsalarga olib kelishi mumkinligini anglab yetishlari kerak va kuzatib borish, qo'lidan ushlash kabilar kam uchraydigan holat emas.

source: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
reference: Erkaklarga rad javob qilishda qat'iy bo'ling va o'z aytganingizda turishdan qo'rqmang (madaniy farqlar borligi yoki yo'qligidan qat'iy nazar bu uni oddiy holatga aylantirmaydi!).

source: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
reference: Oraliq saylovlardagi bir haftalik yo'qotishlardan keyin, Bush ommaga Osiyoda savdo-sotiqning kengayishi to'g'risida so'zlab berdi.

source: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
reference: Bu Genri Luis Geystning PBS kanalidagi "Afrika dunyosi mo'jizalari" maxsus serialidagi asosiy to'xtash nuqtalaridan biri bo'lgan edi.

source: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
reference: Bog' 19 500 km² maydonni qamrab olgan hamda har biri turlicha yovvoyi tabiatni qo'llab-quvvatlovchi 14 ta ekohududga bo'lingan.

source: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
reference: Bosh vazir bilan uchrashuv paytida Layton konservatorlarning atrof-muhit haqidagi qonun loyihasini "batafsil va to'liq qayta yozish"ni, Konservatorlar partiyasining atrof-muhit haqidagi qonun loyihasiga o'zgartishlar kiritishni so'radi.

source: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
reference: Gonkong orolidagi shaharsozlik taraqqiyotining katta qismi shimoliy sohil bo'ylab o'zlashtirilgan yerlarda zich joylashgan.

source: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
reference: Bu ingliz mustamlakachilari o'ziniki deb bilgan joy, shunday ekan, agar siz hududning mustamlaka bo'lgan o'tmishiga dalil diqirayotgan bo'lsangiz, bu yer boshlash uchun yaxshi joydir.

source: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
reference: 1966-yildan beri Sandarban yovvoyi tabiat qo'riqxonasi bo'lib kelmoqda hamda mazkur hududda hozirda 400 ta qirollik Bengal yo'lbarslari va qariyb 30 000 tog' kiyiklari borligi taxmin qilinadi.

source: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
reference: Hamroh taksilar Paro (Nu 150) va Punaxa (Nu 200) singari uzoq bo'lmagan joylarga safar qilishning tez va qulay usullari hisoblanadi.

source: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
reference: Chako mintaqasida Guaykuru va Payagua kabi mahalliy qabilalarning boshqa guruhlari yashab, ular ovchilik, termachilik va baliq ovlash orqali hayotlarini saqlab qolishgan.

source: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
reference: 1537-yili Asunson tashkil topganidan beri Paragvay o'zining tub xususiyatlari va o'ziga xosligining katta qismini saqlab qolishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

source: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
reference: Argentina dunyodagi eng yaxshi polo jamoalaridan biri va o'yinchilariga egaligi bilan mashhur.

source: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
reference: Folklendning rasmiy valyutasi — Folklend funti (FKP) bo'lib, uning qiymati bir Britaniya funtiga (GBP) teng qilib belgilangan.

source: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
reference: Britaniya hamda AQSH valyutasi olinishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, markazdan uzoqdagi orollarda kredit kartalari qabul qilinmasligi mumkin; qanday to'lov usuli qabul qilinishini bilish uchun oldindan egalaridan aniqlashtirib oling.

source: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
reference: Orollardan tashqarida Folklend valyutasini almashtirish deyarli imkonsiz, shu sababli pulni orollarni tark etishdan avval almashtirib oling.

source: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
reference: Montevideo subtropikada joylashgan; yoz oylarida harorat +30°C dan yuqori bo'lishi odatiy hol.

source: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
reference: Tongada katta zarar yoki jarohatlar qayd qilinmagan, lekin elektr energiyasi vaqtincha uzilgan va bu Tonga hukumatiga PTWC tomonidan berilgan sunami ogohlantirishini qabul qilishga xalal bergani xabar qilinmoqda.

source: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
reference: Asosiy mahalliy pivo "Birinchi raqami" bo'lib, u murakkab profilli pivo emas, lekin yoqimli va tetiklantiruvchi. Ikkinchi mahalliy pivoning nomi "Manta".

source: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
reference: "Yassi oq" qahva g'oyasi avstraliyaliklar uchun begona. "Espresso" qora pakana deb nomlanadi, kapuchino qaymoq (ko'pik bilan emas) bilan to'ldirligan bo'ladi, choy esa sutsiz beriladi.

source: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
reference: Akulalar mavjud, biroq ular kamdan-kam hollarda odamlarga hujum qiladi. Ko'pchilik akulalar odamlardan qo'rqadi va uzoqroqqa suzib ketishadi.

source: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
reference: Sayyohlik agentlari odatda nonushta, aeroportga/dan transportni tashkillashtirish yoxud hatto parvoz hamda mehmonxona xizmatlarini o'z ichiga oluvchi to'plamlarni taklif etadi.

source: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
reference: Barcha o'zgartirishlar va so'rovlar bevosita mehmonxonalarga emas, balki avval sayyohlik agentligi orqali yuborilishi kerak.

source: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
reference: Ayrim festivallarda yosh bolalari bo'lgan oilalar uchun maxsus kemping hududlari mavjud bo'ladi.

source: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
reference: Suvni tozalashning turli xil usullari bor, ba'zilari ma'lum xavflarga qarshi ancha samarali hisoblanadi.

source: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
reference: Yuqumli kasalliklarning o'zi yoxud kuch bilan insonlarni jarohatlashi yoxud halok qilishi mumkin bo'lgan xavfli hayvonlar odatda zararkunandalar toifasiga kiritilmaydi.

source: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
reference: o'rnatilgan tezlik chegaralari avvalgi va keyingi qismlariga qaraganda sezilarli darajada past — odatda 35–40 mil/s (56–64 km/s) — va ularga qat'iy rioya qilish boshqalariga qaraganda yanada muhimroq.

source: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
reference: Karri giyohlar hamda ziravorlar bilan birgalikda go'sht yoxud sabzavotlarga asoslangan ovqatdir.

source: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
reference: Hozirda butun arxipelag bo'ylab keng tarqalagan Yava oshxonasi oddiy ziravorlar qo'shilgan taomlardan iborat, yavaliklar yaxshi ko'radigan asosiy ziravorlar yeryong'oq, chili qalampiri, shakar (ayniqsa Yava kokos yong'og'idan olinadigan shakar) va turli xushbo'y ziravorlardir.

source: U mening.
reference: That is mine.

source: Familiyangiz nima?
reference: What is your surname?

source: Yoshim yigirma to'rtda.
reference: I'm 24 years old.

source: Oshpaz bo‘lib ishlayman.
reference: I work as a cook.

source: Nega itlarni shunchalik yomon ko‘rasan?
reference: Why do you hate dogs so much?

source: Ular menga nimadir topishganini aytishdi.
reference: They told me that they found something.

source: Badaviylar choʻlda yashaydi.
reference: Bedouins live in the desert.

source: Xohlagan tilingizda yozishingiz mumkin. Tatoeba saytida barcha tillar tengdir.
reference: You may write in any language you want. On Tatoeba, all languages are equal.

source: Uyda qoling.
reference: Stay home.

source: Do'stlaring kimligini ayt, shunda men kimligingni aytaman.
reference: Tell me who your friends are, and I'll tell you who you are.

source: Kitobimni olib kel
reference: How many sentences have you written today?

source: Tuflimning ichida bir qoya bor.
reference: There's a rock in my shoe.

source: Sen ham kelolasan.
reference: You can come, too.
